title: Add --sort <column>[:asc|:desc] flag to gitpulse CLI
essence: Every analytics command (churn, ownership, hotspots, authors, compare, tags) can now re-order its output by any of its output columns via --sort. Omitting the flag preserves the previous default ordering byte-for-byte.
